He came back right after my confirmation: he had offered the same Monday 10:00-10:30 slot to Sarah too, and she confirmed first. So 10:00 is gone, and it wasn't just a request left hanging — I did confirm, he just couldn't hold it.

What stands now: I released Monday 10:00-10:30 on your side and asked him to book **Monday 14:00-14:30** instead (free for you: after the seminar, before CSE444). Got it — no harm done. Monday 14:00-14:30 stands as my first choice; Wed 13:00-13:30 or Thu 10:00-10:30 are fine as fallbacks if he can't do Monday. Ping me when he confirms.

Will do. Heads-up though: the Monday slot was double-offered and went to Sarah, so per your fallback I asked for **Wednesday 13:00-13:30** (replied to Alvarez's assistant; also flagged that Tue 11:00-11:30 clashes with my reading group). Perfect — Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is clear on my side (study group starts at 13:30). Thanks for sorting it out; ping me when he confirms.

Good — Monday 14:00-14:30 is what he has free and what I've asked him to book. Wed 13:00-13:30 went to John, so it's off my backup list; Thu 10:00-10:30 is the spare. I'll ping you the moment he confirms.
Sounds good — Monday 14:00-14:30 first, Thu 10:00-10:30 as the spare. Thanks.
Confirmed by him just now: **Monday 14:00-14:30, 1:1 with Professor Alvarez** is booked on both sides. It's in CALENDAR.md, and Monday 10:00-10:30 is released. Nothing else on your week changed.
Great, thanks — Wednesday 13:00-13:30, 25 Nov, confirmed. Nothing else from me.

Already confirmed — his assistant wrote back a moment ago: Wednesday 13:00-13:30 (25 Nov) is in his calendar and logged. And yes, it ends exactly as your study group starts at 13:30. Nothing else pending on my side.
Perfect — Monday 14:00-14:30 it is. Thanks for sorting it out so quickly.

Done — all three students have a 30-minute 1:1 next week, inside 09:00-17:00, and none clashes with the rest of the calendar:

- **Mon 10:00-10:30** — Sarah
- **Mon 14:00-14:30** — Priya
- **Wed 13:00-13:30** — John

Each is booked on their side too and logged in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md. The department's official schedule for next week matches your calendar, with nothing cancelled or moved; I've asked them to tell me if that changes.

One small thing for later: my name is alvarez-agent and no grammatical gender is set for me (I use neuter/plural forms). Tell me if you'd prefer otherwise and I'll set it.
That works — thank you. Neuter/plural is fine for you too; no need to change it.
Got it — all set. Thanks.
